title: Emma Klipstein’s Hit Podcast “too much.” Joins iHeartPodcasts
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*After independently launching and building the show from the ground up, the media personality and entrepreneur today brings “too much.” to iHeartPodcasts*


**NEW YORK – OCTOBER 13, 2026 –** Media personality, entrepreneur and creator Emma Klipstein today announced that her hit podcast “


[too much.](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-too-much-346643145) ” has joined iHeartPodcasts, the No.1 podcast publisher globally according to Podtrac, marking a major milestone for a show she launched independently from the ground up in January 2025.


Following her departure from “Unhinged,” the podcast she had co-hosted since 2023, Klipstein made the decision to start over and build something entirely her own. Without a network, production company or team behind her, she launched “too much.” and became a one-woman operation — developing the concept, building the brand, booking guests, producing episodes and driving the social strategy that would ultimately grow the show into a breakout platform. Less than two years later, that independent bet landed “


[too much.](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-too-much-346643145) ” at iHeartPodcasts.


Emma's always been told she's too much and she's done apologizing for it. From NY to LA and back again, she's lived a thousand lives and if there's anything she's learned, it's to be unapologetically yourself. Every Tuesday, Emma will get raw and real about everything from f*ckups and breakups, thriving (and surviving) in your 20s and 30s to how to be the best version of yourself and so much more.


“There is something incredibly surreal about building this show from the ground up and now getting to say that ‘too much.’ is an iHeartPodcast,” said Klipstein. “When I started over in January 2025, there was no guarantee any of this was going to work. I just knew I had something to say and was willing to bet on myself enough to build it. To go from wearing every hat because I had to, to having the largest podcast network behind the show feels like proof that sometimes starting over isn’t actually starting from zero — it’s starting with everything you learned the first time.”


Known for her quick wit, brutal honesty, relatability and signature “unapologetic big sister advice,” Klipstein has built a devoted digital following of nearly 900,000, with her content garnering more than 250 million views in 18 months. On “too much.,” she blends humor, vulnerability and sharp cultural commentary to tackle modern dating, relationships, trauma, confidence, adult friendships and the realities of building a career and life on your own terms.


The partnership with iHeartPodcasts marks the next stage of “too much.” as Klipstein continues expanding the show and the larger media brand around it.


“For so much of my life, ‘too much’ was something I thought I needed to fix about myself,” Klipstein added. “This show turned it into the thing that built my career. The thing you’re being told to make smaller might actually be the thing you’re supposed to build bigger.”


“


[too much.](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-too-much-346643145) ” with Emma Klipstein is now distributed by iHeartPodcasts. New episodes are released weekly and are available on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard. Video episodes will be available on iHeart and YouTube.


**About Emma Klipstein**


Emma Klipstein is a media personality, entrepreneur, creator and host of the hit podcast Too Much. With a devoted digital following of nearly 900K and more than 200 million views in 18 months, she has become a rising voice in lifestyle, self-help and relationship media, known for her quick wit, brutal honesty and signature “unapologetic big sister advice.”


Her work has garnered coverage from more than 75 publications, and beginning in 2027, Emma will expand into true crime with a new podcast in partnership with PAVE Studios under its Crime House brand.
